suites.description: Needs Me tracks owner boundaries, urgency and unlocks truthfully

checks.name: open needs are ordered by urgency and unlock impact
duplicate boundary keys merge instead of prompting twice
a colliding key with a different instruction is rejected rather than silently merged
owner needs never contain credential material fields

suites.description: One resolution clears the boundary permanently without re-asking

checks.name: resolving by key is idempotent and evidence-bearing
already-resolved boundaries are not re-raised by later observation
unknown or malformed resolutions fail closed

suites.description: Completed boundary work resumes every linked route exactly once

checks.name: one resolution fans out to every resume route with preserved scope

suites.description: Onboarding manifests are valid, grouped by unlock impact and dependency-aware

checks.name: manifests reject duplicate ids, unknown dependencies, self-dependency and cycles
setup groups rank by unlock impact
blockers expose exact actions, environments and dependency readiness

suites.description: Foundry capability declarations generate owner needs without duplicate prompts

checks.name: owner needs carry exact instructions, environment and resume routes

suites.description: Boundaries survive restart without re-asking or fabricating resolution

checks.name: snapshot rehydration preserves resolutions and does not re-open cleared work
corrupt or unsupported snapshots fail closed
needs states are limited to explicit boundary outcomes
